Welcome to our interactive research portal. Here we combine satellite earth observation with ground-level field surveys and local knowledge to study the complex relationships between landscapes and human livelihoods.

title: About
text: The Global Institute for Interdisciplinary Studies (GIIS) is an educational institution based in Kathmandu, Nepal. GIIS promotes and conducts interdisciplinary research to generate credible, salient and legitimate knowledge that catalyzes a transformative change in the developmental policies and practices in Nepal and elsewhere. Through deep engagement with decision makers and multiple stakeholders, GIIS aims to shape developmental agenda that is socially-just, environmentally sustainable, and economically viable. Our interdisciplinary team has a strong track record of extensive research in Climate change and Landuse change, Natural resources and the Environment, Geohazards and Disasters, Society and Migration, Global health and Nutrition, Gender and Equality. Currently, we have 15 research fellows and our team is gradually expanding

import leafmap.foliumap as leafmap
from branca.element import Element, MacroElement
from jinja2 import Template

# 1. Increase map height to fill the viewport
m = leafmap.Map(
    center=[28.076559, 84.201371],
    zoom=8,
    height=1000,
    tiles = None
)
m.add_basemap("Esri.WorldShadedRelief")

m.add_raster(
    r"data\nepal_rangeland_image.tif",
    layer_name="Nepal Rangelands",
    vmin=1,
    vmax=1,
    nodata=0,
    colormap=["#2e7d32", "#2e7d32"],
    opacity=1.0,
    zoom_to_layer=False,
)

# 3. Force full-screen size recalculation and centering
class RecenterMap(MacroElement):
    def __init__(self, lat, lon, zoom):
        super().__init__()
        self._template = Template(f"""
            {{% macro script(this, kwargs) %}}
            window.addEventListener("load", function() {{
                setTimeout(function() {{
                    var map = {{{{ this._parent.get_name() }}}};
                    map.invalidateSize();
                    map.setView([{lat}, {lon}], {zoom});
                }}, 300);
            }});
            {{% endmacro %}}
        """)

m.add_child(RecenterMap(28.076559, 84.201371, 8))

# 4. Inject Multiply blend mode for the 2nd layer (your raster)
blend_css = Element("""
<style>
  .leaflet-tile-pane .leaflet-layer:nth-child(2) {
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
  }
</style>
""")
m.get_root().html.add_child(blend_css)

# 5. Render the map as the final expression in the cell
m
